model: Two equal-volume well-mixed ideal dilute compartments at fixed temperature and fixed volumes. Only Na+and Cl-are membrane permeable;the impermeant dianion stays inside. Both bulk compartments are electroneutral. Mobile-ion electrochemical potentials equilibrate with identical standard chemical potentials across the membrane. No complexation,water ionization,activity correction or membrane surface excess is included.
target: Find the nonnegative equilibrium ion concentrations,inside-minus-outside electrical potential and ideal inside-minus-outside osmotic pressure. Count impermeant MOLECULES,not charge equivalents,in osmotic particle concentration. This pressure difference is the hypothetical mechanical counterpressure needed to prevent water flow if water permeability were enabled;volumes do not change in the stipulated calculation.
reporting: Concentrations in mol/L,in the order insideNa,insideCl,outsideNa,outsideCl. Electrical potential in V,osmotic pressure in Pa. A1mol/L particle concentration equals1000mol/m^3. Do not replace the finite outside compartment by an infinite bath.

provenance.kind: Explicit idealized controlled equilibrium study. Numbers are stipulated model inputs,not measured thermochemical or membrane data.
